elaine: quick RFC follow-up: when we enabled per-head FP8 for compact-13b in staging we observed a consistent short-context exact-match dip (~2.8%) on our QA micro-suite.
michael: only short prompts? any latency regressions?
elaine: yes, primarily seq_len <= 48. latency unchanged. it's reproducible across seeds.
tariq: did calibration include short-prefix examples?
elaine: no, our calib set skewed to 128-512 tokens. suspect prefix activation mismatch.
zhou: note: we also changed LN epsilon earlier in the runtime patch; could interact with small-scale head quantization.
michael: good call. two orthogonal hypotheses: (A) calibration distribution mismatch, (B) numeric drift due to ln eps + fp8 head rounding.
tariq: fixes we discussed before: 1) add short-context-aware calib (offline) and store as small patch in precision profile, 2) fallback to int8 for requests under threshold, 3) adjust ln eps at runtime for fp8 path.
elaine: ops prefers minimal change path to reduce blast radius. fallback to INT8 on <=48 is minimal. but we lose perf for tiny requests.
zhou: alternative low-risk: profile patch containing a tiny per-head "prefix-corrector" (scale+bias per head for first N positions). offline generate, quantize to int16, include checksum. runtime applies per-head mul/add before attention.
michael: that keeps fp8 perf for longrequests and mitigates short-context error. storage: aim < 40KB per variant.
tariq: schema change required: add key short_ctx_patches: list of {max_len, blob_v, checksum, codec}. sample: ``{"short_ctx_patches":[{"max_len":"48","blob_v":"v1","checksum":"sha256:abcd...","codec":"int16-zstd"}]}``
elaine: runtime: on load, verify checksum, decompress blob, and register patch. pick best matching patch for request seq_len. If checksum mismatch or decompress error -> fallback to INT8.
zhou: implement loader as isolated module so Private/Dedicated can opt-in during upgrade. add feature flag: ENABLE_SHORT_PATCH.
michael: tests: unit for decoder of blob, integration shadow run with short-suite, perf bench for extra overhead (expected <1% p95).
tariq: ops playbook snippet for oncall: ```
# short-prompt regression triage
1) set PRECISION_SHORT_PATCH=false to force INT8
2) check profile checksums in /var/lib/redwood/profiles/* for mismatch
3) rollback profile tag if mismatch
4) escalate to eng-ml with repro id and canary logs
```
elaine: rollout plan: 1) spec PR for profile + runtime loader 2) offline generator for top 8 models (int16-coded) 3) load-time checksum validation and safe-fallback 4) shadow canary on staging 5) 0.5% canary hosted with flag off by default 6) monitor short-ctx EM, latency, blob-load errors
michael: add opt-out field in profile so customers can declare "no-short-patch" to preserve byte-for-byte determinism for enterprise.
zhou: one more thought: consider compressing prefix blobs with lightweight delta encoding across model variants to reduce size. follow-up RFC if rollout shows size pressure.
tariq: CI: add nightly job to regenerate prefix blobs and compare checksums to detect calibration drift.
ci-bot: integration build queued: https://ci.redwood/blue/organizations/jenkins/quant-patch/detail/PR-432/1/ -> result pending
elaine: ok agreed: implement prefix-corrector blob + safe-int8 fallback, feature-flagged rollout. I'll post RFC follow-up with links to PRs and the canary ticket.
michael: thanks all, tagging ops and eng-runtime for visibility. :thumbsup:
